id: title:charlesvien:auto retry the run stream on a 401

review.posthog_relevance: Desktop agent recovery from Cloud Task authentication failure
review.reason: The implementation hunk P1.F1.H1 explicitly changes CloudTaskStreamError creation to include `autoRetry: true`. This indicates a substantive change to the Cloud Task execution behavior, allowing the desktop agent to recover from a 401 stream token error rather than failing immediately. This represents a bounded reliability improvement for the desktop ingestion path. No score is not

The benefit of the retry behavior is not demonstrated by test assertions or recovery scenarios in the provided observations, and the broader context of the Cloud Task setup is not fully established. This score assumes the retry behavior is a valid and bounded capability

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by test assertions and comments. No implementation changes are supplied. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are the only implementation hunks; P1.F2.H1, P1.F2.H2, P1.F2.H3, P1.F2.H4 are tests. No score can be assigned without the implementation hunks.
